notes.subject: לנפל חללי
notes.rationale: Ḥebrew 'to fall the slain of' — idiom of causing slaughter; kabyle renders as causative 'yegga ad d-ddun'

notes.subject: לבבל נפלו
notes.rationale: Prefix ל read as 'at/in Babylon' (KJV, JPS) vs 'because of Babylon' (BSB); YLT reads 'they of Babylon have fallen'

notes.subject: בבל / לבבל
notes.rationale: Same root with different prefixes mirrors guilt-for-guilt reversal; lost in kabyle as in English

notes.subject: גם ... גם
notes.rationale: Anaphoric 'also/just as ... so also' frames the measure-for-measure symmetry

notes.subject: גם בבל לנפל
notes.rationale: First גם read as comparative 'akken' (as) rather than literal 'also', following the parallel structure

translation: Akken Babil yegga ⟨את⟩ wid yettwakren n Yisrael ad d-ddun, akken deg Babil ddekkren wid yettwakren n tmurt akk.
